challenge.method: Tested whether the copying statement covered only repository software, a button, or a work subsequently placed under CC0. Compared its stated object with the exact file and read the adjacent trademark reservation and asset-specific terms.
challenge.results: The copying sentence expressly names legal-tool text. The file's path, heading and operative clauses place it in that class. The README gives Vocabulary code and fonts separate treatment. Its trademark paragraph governs use of marks and logos. The publisher's dedication of its legal-tool text therefore supplies the basis for copyright redistribution of this file independently of anyone's application of CC0 to another work.

limitations: The finding covers copyright reuse of the identified 7,048-byte plaintext. The exact-byte condition defines the assessed copy.
The publisher separately reserves use of its trademarks and logos, subject to the stated indication-of-license and policy exceptions or prior written consent.
Rights in another work depend on the relevant Affirmer applying CC0 and on the rights that person holds.
reasoning: The pinned README applies CC0 to “the text of the Creative Commons legal tools”. The file at the same commit is the English text of one such tool. Its exact reproduction and redistribution fall within section 1(i)'s reproduction and distribution rights, addressed by the section 2 waiver and, to the extent the waiver is judged ineffective, the section 3 fallback license.
